'''Stormwing''' was a name of the personal [[Fleft-wauf/Legends|fleft-wauf]] of the [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raider]] [[Jeru]] from [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the bird saved the life of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] by catching her while she was falling from a great height. Later, it managed to destroy at least one [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droid]].
